numeric_prefix_fix.original_failure_mode: JSONDecoder.raw_decode can return the integer prefix of an incomplete decimal or exponent, such as 1 from a buffer ending in 1. or 1e-.
numeric_prefix_fix.final_behavior: A successful decode is accepted only with EOF or a following structural/whitespace delimiter. A non-delimiter before EOF requests more input; the same invalid suffix at EOF raises JSONDecodeError.
numeric_prefix_fix.static_conclusion: The final condition closes the identified prefix boundary defect without dropping or prematurely consuming buffered characters.
numeric_prefix_fix.boundary_smoke_execution: Root reported standard-decoder equivalence and single-character numeric-boundary smoke PASS. This reviewer did not rerun the smoke.

preserved_gates.gate: Top-level keys are strings and unique; both streaming fields are arrays; element separators and closing delimiters are consumed explicitly; trailing JSON data is rejected; both required array fields must occur.

Each module appears once. Raw parts and part identities have equal lengths. Each zipped pair binds requested_path, resolved identity.path and module exactly. Each projected module/facet key appears once, so zip truncation and projected-key overwrite cannot silently discard a part.

Global module/facet keys and recorded resolved paths are unique; fresh external authorities remain rejected; the object basename agrees with module and facet; the full global bound row is included in its canonical digest.
Only the recorded requested path and recorded resolved identity path enter the alias index. An alias can repeat only with the identical module, facet and SHA256 assignment.

Roots and counts match the supplied contract. Modules represented by global facets equal the actual module set. Projected and global full-row digest maps agree, and their key sets equal the global facet index.

The final old/new comparison still requires after with MOD removed to equal before exactly, and the MOD portion to equal only (MOD, .olean) bound to the actual newly produced object's SHA256. Counts remain before 6184 modules/30820 facets and after 6185 modules/30821 facets.
